rankedFindings.finding: Reject this single sparse LOD1 whorl as insufficient visual return for its extra geometry. Small branches are discernible on exposed trunks, especially riverfront foreground trees; they do not repair the dominant separated leaf-card clumps, flat crown reading or distant impostor silhouettes. No major new harmful visual regression is established by the supplied views.

Verified canonical LOD1 cost rises from 308 vertices/168 triangles to 368/240, +60 vertices/+72 triangles (+42.857% triangles). Draw calls and reported local LOD counts stay equal in all three pairs. This is a geometry increase, not a CPU optimization or demonstrated FPS failure.

Crown coherence, impostor quality, sparse park composition and night crown readability remain open. This bounded branch rejection does not close any whole-game issue or show that all branch treatments would fail.

limitations: Independent review of supplied captures and source, not an independently rerun browser experiment or new whole-game review. Six originals and three derived crop pairs were individually inspected.

Three matched views at one seed and high quality do not establish all species, weather, camera, LOD-transition, or save/restore behavior. No fresh reference calibration or blind judging was performed in this bounded rejection audit.

Single fresh-page observations, accepted block before candidate block, are not a repeated interleaved timing experiment. FPS and raw endpoint heap cannot establish a performance regression, improvement, memory leak, or gate pass.

Pixel MAE was recomputed from all RGB pixels of each original pair. Live traffic/runtime variation contributes; neither MAE nor crop inspection isolates every foliage pixel or proves image equivalence.

Riverfront total triangle delta is 28512, equivalent to 396 added 72-triangle submissions, versus 135 trees in the reported local LOD1 histogram. Render/reflection composition is a plausible explanation, but no pass-by-pass submission ledger proves its exact allocation.

All six owner stats fields are null. Public Props API keys and LOD histograms exist, but no full record digest, serialized-state equality, API contract, or double-restore result was collected for this disposable candidate.

Source hashes identify current raw source and the exactly reconstructed candidate. The tool fetches Vite-transformed source and replaces the marker; it does not retain a hash/archive of each served transformed body.

The builder reports an earlier invalid bare-import routing run whose files were overwritten. That historical run cannot be independently reconstructed from these retained artifacts; all six current sidecars are valid.

No full matrix/build/restore rerun is necessary merely to reject a never-installed routed candidate and retain the unchanged accepted tree source. Those missing checks would matter before accepting a future product change.
